_about: Each pair is a real integration run on a fresh GitHub runner: install both, make one real call through the pair, record the versions and the result. circuit reads results/latest.json and marks a pair that ran as tier 2 for that connection; a failure is a dated negative fact.

pairs.what: LiteLLM routes a chat completion to a local Ollama model
LangChain's ChatOllama gets an answer from a local Ollama model
LlamaIndex's Ollama LLM completes a prompt on a local Ollama model
LangChain writes vectors to Qdrant and searches them back
LlamaIndex indexes documents in Qdrant and retrieves them
Haystack writes documents to a Qdrant document store and reads them back
LlamaIndex indexes documents in Chroma and retrieves them
psycopg stores a pgvector embedding in Postgres and finds its nearest neighbour
LangChain's PGVector store writes and searches vectors in Postgres

not_runnable_yet.why: vLLM needs a GPU; GitHub's free runners have none
needs a paid account; comes later with circuit-owned, spend-capped keys
